title: On the Effectiveness and Limitations of Open-Weight LLMs for Low-Resource Offensive Language Detection in Danish
abstract: arXiv:2611.09506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the effectiveness and robustness of open-weight large language models (LLMs) for Danish offensive language detection, an underexplored low-resource task. We evaluate four model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Qwen) across eleven prompting strategies spanning five design categories, cross-prompt generalization, Danish orthographic variation, and robustness under balanced and naturally imbalanced class distributions. We compare against three BERT-family baselines with distinct pre-training strategies, evaluated via both masked language model prompting and supervised fine-tuning. Even without task-specific fine-tuning, LLMs can surpass all three fine-tuned BERT baselines, and lightweight finetuning yields substantial further gains. No single model or prompt category dominates, underscoring that prompt design interacts with model pre-training in ways that cannot be predicted a priori. Semantically grounded prompts transfer more

translated_title: 《开放权重大语言模型在丹麦语低资源冒犯性语言检测中的有效性与局限性研究》
translated_abstract: 我们研究了开放权重大语言模型（LLM）在丹麦语冒犯性语言检测任务中的有效性与鲁棒性，这是一个尚未被充分探索的低资源任务。我们评估了四个模型家族，采用涵盖五种设计类别的十一种提示策略，考察了跨提示泛化能力、丹麦语拼写变体的影响，以及在均衡类别分布和自然不均衡类别分布下的鲁棒性。我们将其与三种采用不同预训练策略的BERT家族基线进行比较，这些基线通过掩码语言模型提示和有监督微调两种方式加以评估。结果表明，即使不进行任务特定的微调，大语言模型也能超越所有三个经过微调的BERT基线，而轻量级微调还能带来显著的额外提升。没有任何单一模型或提示类别能够占据全面优势，这凸显了提示设计与模型预训练之间存在无法先验预测的交互作用。基于语义的提示具有更强的迁移性……
tldr: 该研究系统评估了四个开放权重LLM家族在丹麦语低资源冒犯性语言检测中的表现，发现LLM即使不微调也能超越微调后的BERT基线，且提示设计与模型预训练的交互作用无法被先验预测。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates four open-weight LLM families on low-resource Danish offensive language detection, showing that LLMs can surpass fine-tuned BERT baselines even without task-specific fine-tuning, while prompt design interacts with model pre-training in unpredictable ways.
